subject: Quick heads-up about the shared workbench
text:
I’ve been thinking about the shared workbench and wanted to give you a quick heads-up. If you had planned to use it over the weekend, my project may need to start earlier because the hardware shop said my parts will arrive by Friday afternoon.

I know that’s short notice, and I don’t want to interfere with your plans. If Friday or Saturday morning doesn’t work, just let me know, and I can shift later. I’ll make sure the area is left tidy and wiped down before I go. Thanks for being flexible, thank you.
